decisions.rationale: Ruined curtain module: the wall broken off between 3.5 and 8.8 m along a jagged sloping line under a mossy coping, with fallen blocks at its foot; 238 triangles, 19,764 bytes before meshopt. Everything stays inside its collider below 3 m and within 0.8 m above it (world-assets footprint test); baked AO at 48 samples.
limitations: Every ruined module is the same mesh (turned), so a long ruined run repeats every 12 m.
Breaks are straight-cut slabs; no rubble slope spills beyond the few fallen blocks.
Masonry is the castle surface layer tiled every 3 m and the moss layer every 2 m; there is no unique wear, grime gradient or decal per piece.

decisions.rationale: In the Old Fort's fallen stretch, Thornwatch, the Old Cloister and the Sealed Vault; modules turn end for end at random along a run, at gameplay cameras (18-40 m, pitch 0.38-1.13): reads at true scale beside the 2.25 m soldier, the 2.7 m captain and the 3.9 m boss, with shadows on the level castle ground. The sightline cutaway shows the hero through it (castle browser suite: 100% of hero pixels visible behind a citadel curtain with the cutaway, 0.4% without), and a camera inside its bounds plus 2 m hides it instead of showing the hollow inside.
limitations: Castles and ruins are scenery: no doors open, no interiors and no reachable walls or towers.
